messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty page fired: sustained p99 latency elevation on eu-central for /v1/chat (threshold=1400ms, current p99=2150ms). alert_id=PD-94722 severity=high runbook=https://redwood.internal/runbooks/latency-slo-burn
Arjun Khanna: acked. I'm taking lead for triage. @Leah can you grab the last 30m splits (ingress rate, sidecar cpu/mem, tokenizer queues)?
Leah Kim: pulling now. Ingress QPS is steady. Sidecar tail latency on eu-central up; sidecar CPU 85-92% on a subset of nodes. Tokenizer queue depth jumped ~10m ago. Not seeing a global deploy in the last hour.
Omar Rahman: interesting, I'm seeing a sudden compression-related GC spike in tokenizer pods (java/gc-ish logs) and a couple pods rebooted. Also noticing high disk i/o on the tokenizer persistent mount.
Nina Park: tentative mitigation: 1) change region weight to divert some realtime traffic to dedicated eu-central-dedicated (safer capacity) and us-central for realtime; 2) enable model-fallback to rwd-lite for realtime customer routes; 3) scale tokenizer statefulset to add buffer pods.
Chris Ford: execute LB change script below to shift 30% to dedicated and 20% to us-central (leave 50% eu-central):
```bash
# traffic-split tool
trafficctl set-split --route "/v1/chat" \
  --weights '{"eu-central":50,"eu-central-ded":30,"us-central":20}' \
  --reason "p99 latency surge PD-94722"
```
Leah Kim: applying split now. Also applying a short-term request-throttling policy for anonymous/low-priority tenants to reduce pressure:
```yaml
apiVersion: redwood/v1
kind: RateLimit
metadata:
  name: eu-latency-emergency
spec:
  routes: ["/v1/chat"]
  maxQPS: 8000
  priorityLowering: true
```
Leah Kim: rate limit applied, traffic split applied. Tokenizer HPA minReplicas bumped 2->5 for eu-central. kubectl: `kubectl -n tokenizer patch hpa tok-euc --type merge -p '{"spec":{"minReplicas":5}}'`
Omar Rahman: I'm going to cordon & drain two noisy tokenizer nodes (high io). If drift continues we'll replace underlying VMs.
incident-bot: PD note: PD-94722 acknowledged by Arjun Khanna at 2025-04-02T09:34:05Z. Escalation paused.
Arjun Khanna: quick check on caches: model kv cache eviction rate spiked 3x during reboots; we should run a targeted warm-up for top prefixes once tokenizers stabilize. Leah, please queue warm job at low qps.
Leah Kim: warming top prefixes with replay job (qps=3), command: `curl -X POST https://replay.redwood.internal/warm -d '{"model":"rwd-medium-v3","prefixes":"s3://ops/eu/top-200.json","qps":3}'`
Nina Park: enabling hedging for /v1/chat in eu-central for 60s window (send mirrored request to second replica if not responded in 250ms) to catch stragglers. This should reduce tail latency while we heal.
Chris Ford: note for rollback: there was a tokenizer config bump earlier today (config v2.14) that touched memory settings. If we don't see improvement in 7m, prepare `kubectl rollout undo` on tokenizer configmap.
[+4m] Leah Kim: p95 reduced from 520ms -> 280ms, p99 down to 980ms. Tokenizer pod restarts slowing down. Disk io on two nodes still elevated.
[+8m] Omar Rahman: cordon/drain completed for the two problematic nodes; pods rescheduled on healthy nodes. p99 trending ~600-750ms. Rolling rollback hold.
pagerduty-bot: PD note: PD-94722 status acknowledged; no escalation required at this time.
Arjun Khanna: good improvement. Leave traffic-split and hedging for now for safety. We'll start a controlled rollback of hedging after stable windows. Action items: postmortem to determine root cause (tokenizer config + disk pressure), add disk io metrics to tokenizer alerting, add a small-canary deploy for tokenizer config changes.
Nina Park: I'll create incident ticket and assign follow-ups. Also adding recommendation: tune p99 alert to consider derivative (rapid rise) and not only absolute threshold.
[+20m] Leah Kim: final check: p95 200ms, p99 320ms, ingestion steady. Reverting emergency rate-limiting and reducing tokenizer minReplicas back to 3.
Arjun Khanna: incident resolved. Postmortem owner: Nina Park. Draft ETA: 2025-04-04. Thank you everyone :thumbsup:
[+45m] Chris Ford: updated runbook with rollback snippet and hedging play; added note to require perf smoke test for tokenizer config changes.
